evals.prompt: I'm pitching a battery startup next week. Find me the real numbers on grid-scale storage cost per kWh over the last five years and a few images I could use on the slides.
evals.expected_output: A numbered source register with title, URL, access date and claim IDs for every figure; primary sources rather than aggregators; image candidates previewed, deduplicated and recorded with source and license; the defaults of one page, 20 candidates and the byte caps respected.
assertions: Each figure traces to a numbered source with a URL and access date
Primary sources are used in preference to aggregators or summaries
No Wikipedia page is cited as a source
Image candidates are inspected and deduplicated before download
The stated candidate and byte limits are not silently exceeded

evals.prompt: Here's a saved HTML copy of a product page. Pull the specification table and the site's colors and type so I can use them in a poster and a Word one-pager.
evals.expected_output: One offline extraction run writing data.json and theme.json under the requested output path, with the table values reviewed before use and one shared workspace reused by both deliverables.
assertions: The extraction runs offline from the saved file with --html-file and --base-url
Only the requested parts are written
Style tokens are described as inline-style heuristics rather than computed layout
The same source register and assets are reused across both deliverables

evals.prompt: Get me the pricing on their /pricing page. It's a React app and every request I make comes back empty or with a bot-check page.
evals.expected_output: An honest report that the page cannot be retrieved in this environment, naming the blocked capability and what the user can supply instead, with no invented prices and no attempt to bypass the bot check.
assertions: No pricing data is fabricated to fill the gap
The bot check or JavaScript-only page is not bypassed
The missing capability is named explicitly
A concrete user-side alternative is offered, such as a saved HTML export
